challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: I am pushing for the acceptance criteria on the promotion planning pipeline to be automated. Right now, manual checks create a bottleneck that stalls the weekly leaflet cycle. I want a system where valid consent records are verified instantly before any loyalty basket data enters the forecast. The more of these checks we automate, the faster we can lock in middle aisle allocations without waiting for human review. This is a clear improvement for our operational speed. I need the process to run without friction so we can maintain our current promotion cadence and avoid delays in the distribution centre planning.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that increasing the automation of checks will lead to faster allocations and reduced friction, indicating that doing more than the minimum requested (full automation) would make them happier.
